learning_objective: 就医时,孩子能在预演后进入诊室、在候诊区安坐等待,并配合完成检查的≥2 个关键步骤(如张嘴、量身高),提示下达成。
intro_zh: 今天我要去看医生,做一次健康检查。医生很温和,会帮我看看身体好不好。我先了解一下会发生什么。
intro_en: Today I am going to the doctor for a check-up. The doctor is kind and will check that my body is healthy. First, I learn what will happen.

steps.text_zh: 先在候诊室安静地坐着等。
steps.text_en: First I sit and wait quietly in the waiting room.
steps.narration_zh: 到了诊所,我先在候诊室安静地坐着等,可以看看绘本。
steps.narration_en: At the clinic, I sit and wait quietly in the waiting room. I can look at a picture book.

steps.text_zh: 轮到我,我走进诊室,和医生打招呼。
steps.text_en: When it is my turn, I go in and greet the doctor.
steps.narration_zh: 轮到我了,我走进诊室,对医生说“你好”。
steps.narration_en: When it is my turn, I go into the room and say hello to the doctor.

steps.text_zh: 医生请我张开嘴、量量身高,我配合做。
steps.text_en: The doctor asks me to open my mouth and measure my height; I cooperate.
steps.narration_zh: 医生请我张开嘴看一看,量一量身高,我照着做,很配合。
steps.narration_en: The doctor asks me to open my mouth and measures my height; I do it and cooperate.

steps.text_zh: 检查做完了,我做得很好。
steps.text_en: The check-up is done, and I did great.
steps.narration_zh: 检查做完了,医生说我做得很好,我也为自己高兴。
steps.narration_en: The check-up is done, the doctor says I did great, and I feel proud of myself.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 到了诊所,还没轮到你。轮到你,试试看该怎么做。
practice_trials.prompt_en: You are at the clinic and it is not your turn yet. Your turn — what can you do?
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我先在候诊室安静地坐着等。
practice_trials.answer_en: I sit and wait quietly in the waiting room.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你安静地等待,做得很好。

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 医生请你张开嘴看一看,你可以怎么做?
practice_trials.prompt_en: The doctor asks you to open your mouth. What can you do?
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我张开嘴,配合医生看一看。
practice_trials.answer_en: I open my mouth and let the doctor take a look.
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You cooperated with the doctor. Great job.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 检查的时候有点紧张,你可以怎么帮自己?
practice_trials.prompt_en: If you feel a little nervous during the check-up, how can you help yourself?
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我做一个深呼吸,告诉自己“一会儿就好了”。
practice_trials.answer_en: I take a deep breath and tell myself it will be over soon.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你用深呼吸让自己放松,做得好。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You used a deep breath to relax. Well done.

social_choice.scenario_zh: 在诊室里,医生要给你做检查……你可以怎么做?
social_choice.scenario_en: In the room, the doctor is going to examine you... what can you do?

options.outcome_zh: 你配合医生一步步做完检查,很快就好了,医生夸你很棒。
options.outcome_en: You cooperate step by step, the check-up is soon done, and the doctor says you did great.

options.label_en: If nervous, take a deep breath first
options.outcome_zh: 你觉得紧张时先深呼吸,让自己平静一点,再继续配合检查。
options.outcome_en: When you feel nervous, you take a deep breath, feel calmer, and keep cooperating.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 候诊等待 → 进诊室 → 配合检查 → 做完啦
visual_cards.caption_en: Wait → Go in → Cooperate → All done

visual_cards.caption_zh: 医生你好。 / 一会儿就好了。
visual_cards.caption_en: Hello, doctor. / It will be over soon.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 有点紧张 → 深呼吸 → 平静一点
visual_cards.caption_en: A little nervous → Deep breath → Calmer

visual_cards.caption_zh: 张开嘴 · 量身高 · 听听心跳
visual_cards.caption_en: Open mouth · Measure height · Listen to heartbeat

review_zh: 我知道看医生会发生什么了:先安静候诊,轮到我就进诊室、和医生打招呼,配合张嘴、量身高。有点紧张时我就深呼吸。检查做完,我做得很好!
review_en: Now I know what happens at the doctor: I wait quietly, go in when it is my turn, greet the doctor, and cooperate by opening my mouth and getting measured. If I feel nervous, I take a deep breath. The check-up is done — I did great!
review_flags: 草稿·需专业审核:就医/医疗属敏感主题,须专业人员与家长按孩子情况把关,配合分级暴露与预演,语气平静赋能、非恐吓;不得把检查描述为疼痛或惩罚。
方法:本课以 video_modeling(分步示范看诊流程)为训练模块方法;社交叙事/社交故事(social_narratives)是本主题的互补形式,宜由专业人员配合个别化社交故事一并使用。
医疗/牙科脱敏与配合的特异性一手实证待补(见 design/video_lesson_ideas.md TODO_CITATION),商用前须补齐核对。
